newsitem.title: USA: MMI off on revenue shortfall, downgrade.
newsitem.headline: MMI off on revenue shortfall, downgrade.

text.p: MMI Cos, which took in less revenue than expected last year and missed its budget assumptions, paid for its mistakes Friday, analysts said, as the health care risk management firm's shares fell 6-5/8 to 22-7/8.
One analyst called the sell-off, exacerbated by a downgrade of the stock by Smith Barney, an over-reaction.
"It seems extreme to me," said ABN AMRO Chicago Corp analyst Steven Schwartz. "This company is basically selling at around book value now. It's definitely worth more than that."
Deerfield, Ill.-based MMI on Thursday reported 1996 revenues of $243.2 million, versus $218.7 million in 1995. Profits were $21 million for 1996, down from $22.7 million in the preceding year.
